## 🛠️ Type of Change
Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Style changes (formatting, missing semi colons, etc; no code change)

- [ ] 🧪 Tests (adding missing tests, refactoring tests; no production code change)
- [ ] 🔧 Chore (updating grunt tasks etc; no production code change)

## 🔍 Code Review Checklist

### General
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

### API Changes (if applicable)
- [ ] API changes are backward compatible
- [ ] New endpoints follow RESTful principles
- [ ] Proper error handling is implemented
- [ ] Rate limiting is considered
- [ ] API documentation is updated

### Frontend Changes (if applicable)
- [ ] Components are responsive on mobile and desktop
- [ ] Accessibility standards are maintained
- [ ] Cross-browser compatibility is considered
- [ ] Performance impact is minimal

## 🔐 Security
